messages:
Maria: Running the new smoketest harness against candidate kernels — ampere-midseq focus. Saw intermittent tail spikes (p99) on seqlen=1024 for a subset of kernels. Posting quick notes + logs.
perf-ci-bot: nightly run summary: https://ci.redwood/infer/2934567000/logs — 6 fails / 14 passes / 2 flaky
Ajay: Can you drop the microbench output inline? suspect KV-cache eviction thrash or bad batching shapes.
Maria: quick snippet from the harness:
```
kernel: kv-opt-v2
bench: midseq-micro
seqlen: 1024
p50: 3.2ms  p95: 48.1ms  p99: 110.2ms
kv_miss_rate: ~12% (steps 120-160)
notes: spikes correlate with increased evictions
```
Lee: that pattern screams pathological batching. If short+mid seqs mix, continuous batching may create weird padding -> kernel selection picks a slow path. Can we force fixed_batching=false in the harness and repro?
Sam: scheduled a rerun with fixed_batching=false and per-arch gating. Job queued as 2934567901. Also enabled extra KV metrics (eviction_count, cold_miss_ratio) for that job.
perf-ci-bot: rerun queued: job 2934567901 (owner: Sam)
Maria: one more discovery: one failing kernel artifact had different compiler flags in the build step (-O3 vs -O2). Binary hash mismatch. That would invalidate perf numbers.
Ajay: if compile flags drift, CI should fail gating. I'll open a tiny PR to embed the compiler flags + binary hash into artifacts and abort on mismatch.
Sam: PR #4212 opened: ci/artifacts: add binary_hash and build_flags to metadata — will enforce equality in the harness check.
Lee: low-effort win: add microprobe variants at sequence breakpoints (64/128/256/512/1024) that emit both picked kernel id and observed latency. Autotuner can use that map to learn seqlen -> kernel mapping per arch.
Maria: yes, and extend harness to record KV cache warmup windows (prefix-warmup count) so we can separate cold-start noise from steady-state.
Ajay: also suggest adding a short prefix-caching warmup pass for microbench to reduce cold-start variance when we're trying to compare kernels deterministically.
Sam: doing that in the rerun. Also toggled kernel-selection to prefer arch-aware picks (ampere-optimized) as a temporary fallback.
perf-ci-bot: job 2934567901 started
Maria: will paste the full rerun logs + picked-kernel map when job finishes. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:
Ajay: once we have rerun, we should add a gating rule: if p95 regression > 25% vs baseline for same binary_hash -> mark candidate flaky and require manual review.
Lee: agreed. And emit a compact CSV that maps seqlen -> kernel_id -> p50/p95 so perf dashboards can ingest easily.
Sam: noted. I'll attach rerun artifacts to the job and notify infra on the compile-flag flake.
Maria: thanks everyone. If rerun still shows flakiness we'll escalate to runtime infra for deeper KV cache tracing.
perf-ci-bot: job 2934567901 completed: 4 fails / 16 passes / 1 flaky — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/infer/2934567901/artifacts
Maria: uploaded picked-kernel-map.csv and kv_evictions.log. Starting triage now.
